about_the_game:
A success story born from loneliness, debt, and filth.

Your wife left you. Your home is gone. Your life is ruined.
Just when everything seemed over… a flyer hit your head:
"Cheap Rental: Old Bus Station Toilet"

And so, Toilet Simulator began.

Your New Life: Running a Public Toilet

Take an abandoned, filthy public toilet and turn it into the region’s top hygiene spot.
Clean it, decorate it, choose the toilets, even place the soap dispensers.
But beware: this is just the beginning.

Manage, Upgrade, Expand!

  • Build your own toilet empire.

  • Unlock new locations: from gas stations to shopping malls.

  • Cater to your customers' needs... some are in desperate situations.

A Job Full of Dangers

  • Pervs, thieves, lunatics, and more will invade your restroom.

  • Police raids, unexpected guests, and shady events await.

  • Install security cameras, set traps, or simply lock the door!

A Realistic & Absurd Experience

  • A unique mix of comedy, drama, and light horror.

  • Every customer has a story.

  • Some just need to pee… some are here for other reasons.

Everything Is in Your Hands

  • Upgrade your toilet, hire a cleaning team, and test new soap brands.

  • Set the best "WC Entry Fee" in town.

  • Or make it free and rely on donation boxes. The risk is yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4000 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT

short_description: Buy an old, dirty public toilet, clean it, decorate it, and run it! Deal with customers, level up, and move on to new toilets. An absurd toilet simulation filled with everything from perverts and police to thieves and people who wet themselves!
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
